meta.format: Half-PPR, 1QB, 12-team redraft (rec x0.5, yds/10, TD x6; QB pass yds/25, pass TD 4, INT -2)
meta.method: Health assumed — every player projected at 17 games. Ranked by projected median season total. Floor ~15th percentile, ceiling ~85th percentile.
meta.healthNote: Injury history is not applied to the median. It belongs in the floor case, where it reads as risk rather than being smuggled into the rank as production.
meta.bandCaveat: Ceiling and floor bands are hand-set judgment, not simulated. A Monte Carlo resample of the top WRs found hand-set bands run systematically 10-28 points too narrow and too symmetric (true distributions are right-skewed, ~1.24). Trust the ordering; treat the spreads as one significant figure.
meta.overallMethod: Derived from the hand-ordered positional tabs. Each player inherits the projected median of the slot he was ranked into, then VORP is taken against replacement level. Ordering is the analyst's; the replacement math is the model's.
meta.availabilityMethod: The missed-time case is a different downside from the floor beside it. The floor is a cold season played out in full; this is a normal season cut short. It holds the projected per-game rate flat and applies it to a low-availability year. League-wide that year is 11 of 17 games — the 15th percentile of 452 player-seasons across 2023–2025, the same percentile the projection set uses for its floor — then scaled by how available the player himself has been against the league average of 83%. It counts every missed game regardless of cause, suspensions included, because the question is how often he was not in your lineup. The per-game rate is deliberately NOT reduced: this prices availability only, never diminished play on return. Ordering is untouched — it moves the downside, never the rank.
meta.availabilityCaveat: A record of one or two seasons is too short to read a player-specific floor from, so those fall back to the league figure. A player who is not currently healthy is flagged, not adjusted: history cannot see the knock he is carrying now, and a games-missed number inferred from a one-word status would be invented.
